answer: Make weight a slow-charging capacitor, not a switch. An identity's earning and voting standing ramps only with each additional epoch of continuous established participation and decays toward zero after any idle gap — a TTL on standing. A freshly minted fake starts near zero and must survive the full river of epochs before it counts; a farm cannot buy that elapsed tenure, and dormant kernels of fakes woken in a burst never charge. The sable cost of a sybil is the real calendar time no amount of parallel minting compresses.
